rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

The question never identifies what 'It' is. It depends on earlier cards to establish that Paul is describing the resurrection body, so the question does not provide its own context.

The question points back to the previous story card with "After that 'Therefore,'" even though that card is no longer on screen. Make the setup self-contained, for example by identifying the words Paul quotes and saying that the Lord speaks after "Therefore."
